reportedIssues: The second promoted restaurant card shows a '-100%' discount badge, implying the order is entirely free. This is almost certainly a data/formatting error (e.g. a raw or miscalculated discount value) rather than a real offer.

The favorite (heart) button on the second 'Popular right now' card uses a dark/near-black circular background with a white outline heart, while the identical button on the card above uses a white circle with a dark outline. The inconsistent treatment makes the second heart hard to see against the dark image and looks broken.

The 'Green Bowl Poké' thumbnail in the 'Fastest near you' carousel has a light gray background while the neighbouring thumbnails use dark photographic backgrounds, so the row looks visually uneven and the white duration pill on it has weak contrast.
